title: Architecture review and transition-to-implementation decision dossier
flow: Reconcile ARC-001 through ARC-019 draft deliverables with original historical artifacts
Review each ADR, domain boundary, API/event contract, architecture security and test plan
Map unresolved regulatory and financial conflicts to dependent production slices
Collect legal, CFO, CISO, Operations and Architecture reviewer decisions separately
Accept only bounded portions with complete applicable Definition of Ready evidence
Version approved baseline and preserve rejected alternatives and open findings
rules: A pushed batch ZIP proves custody, not architectural acceptance
Do not advance disputed accounting, credit classification or settlement behavior to implementation
No single reviewer can override critical legal/financial/security rejection
Historical work package numbers cannot be silently mapped to new ARC identifiers
Implementation release must reference current effective institution profile and approved source instruments
Maintain immutable review evidence and a new review whenever material assumptions change
acceptance_cases: Audit 19 preceding architecture drafts for acceptance evidence
Try to approve without reviewer and expect rejection
Reject an implementation slice with P0 dependency
Verify independent unrelated context can pass only its own 15 DoR checks
Confirm approval decision preserves exact Git commit and evidence digests
review_gate: Named independent reviewers, completed historical reconciliation and signed per-slice DoR review.
